# Implementing API for TODO App with Django

## Course Overview

This course teaches you how to build a production-ready REST API for a TODO application using Django and Django REST Framework (DRF). You'll progress from basic CRUD operations to advanced patterns including authentication, permissions, filtering, pagination, and testing.

**Who it's for:**
- Backend developers transitioning to API development
- Full-stack engineers needing solid Django API skills
- Candidates preparing for mid-level backend engineering interviews
- Developers building real-world applications with Django

**Why it matters for interview prep:**
- REST API design is a core competency in backend interviews
- Django is widely used in production systems at scale
- Testing, authentication, and performance optimization are interview staples
- Building a complete TODO API demonstrates end-to-end thinking
- This path covers architectural patterns used across industry codebases

---

## Core Topics Covered

- **Django Fundamentals & Project Setup** – Models, migrations, ORM basics, project structure
- **Django REST Framework Essentials** – Serializers, viewsets, routers, request/response handling
- **Authentication & Authorization** – Token auth, JWT, permissions, user management
- **Advanced Querying & Filtering** – Query optimization, pagination, search, ordering
- **Testing & Validation** – Unit tests, integration tests, model validation, edge cases
- **Error Handling & Logging** – Custom exceptions, status codes, debugging strategies
- **Performance & Optimization** – Query optimization (select_related, prefetch_related), caching
- **Documentation & API Design** – OpenAPI/Swagger, versioning, best practices

---

## Learning Path Workflow

### **Phase 1: Foundation (Tasks 1–20)**
1. Set up Django project and virtual environment
2. Create models for Task, User, Category entities
3. Set up database with migrations
4. Understand Django ORM basics (CRUD operations)
5. Install and configure Django REST Framework
6. Create basic serializers for your models
7. Implement viewsets and routers
8. Test basic GET requests with curl/Postman
9. Implement POST (create) with validation
10. Handle DELETE and UPDATE operations
11. Understand HTTP status codes
12. Add model relationships (ForeignKey, ManyToMany)
13. Serialize nested relationships
14. Implement basic filtering
15. Add pagination to list endpoints
16. Understand request/response cycle in DRF
17. Create custom manager methods
18. Add model methods and properties
19. Test with Django TestCase
20. Debug with print statements and logging

### **Phase 2: Authentication & Permissions (Tasks 21–40)**
21. Implement user registration endpoint
22. Add token authentication to API
23. Understand JWT tokens vs session tokens
24. Configure TokenAuthentication in settings
25. Add login endpoint
26. Implement logout functionality
27. Create IsAuthenticated permission class
28. Implement custom permission classes (IsOwner)
29. Test authenticated endpoints
30. Add password hashing and validation
31. Implement password change endpoint
32. Create role-based access control (RBAC)
33. Restrict tasks by user ownership
34. Test permission denial scenarios
35. Add token expiration handling
36. Implement refresh token logic
37. Create user profile endpoint
38. Add user update functionality
39. Test permission classes with different users
40. Audit user actions

### **Phase 3: Advanced Querying & Filtering (Tasks 41–60)**
41. Implement filtering by status (completed/pending)
42. Add filtering by due date
43. Create search functionality (title/description)
44. Implement date range filtering
45. Add ordering by multiple fields
46. Use DjangoFilterBackend for complex filters
47. Create custom filter classes
48. Implement full-text search
49. Optimize queries with select_related()
50. Use prefetch_related() for many-to-many
51. Create database indexes
52. Profile query performance
53. Implement pagination with custom page sizes
54. Handle large datasets efficiently
55. Add limit/offset pagination
56. Implement cursor-based pagination
57. Filter by user-defined tags/categories
58. Create nested filtering (filter tasks in a category)
59. Implement faceted search
60. Test query performance with Django Debug Toolbar

### **Phase 4: Testing & Validation (Tasks 61–75)**
61. Write unit tests for serializers
62. Test model validation
63. Write integration tests for API endpoints
64. Test CRUD operations with fixtures
65. Create test factories for generating test data
66. Test edge cases (empty lists, null values)
67. Test error responses (400, 403, 404, 500)
68. Implement test coverage reporting
69. Test authentication flows
70. Test permission enforcement
71. Validate input with custom validators
72. Test concurrent operations
73. Test data consistency
74. Use mocking for external dependencies
75. Load testing and performance testing

### **Phase 5: Error Handling & Advanced Features (Tasks 76–85)**
76. Implement custom exception handlers
77. Add validation error messages
78. Handle database errors gracefully
79. Implement rate limiting
80. Add request logging
81. Create audit logs for task modifications
82. Implement soft deletes (mark as deleted)
83. Add versioning to API endpoints
84. Implement bulk operations (batch update/delete)
85. Add transaction handling for atomicity

### **Phase 6: Documentation & Deployment (Tasks 86–99)**
86. Generate API documentation with drf-spectacular
87. Create OpenAPI/Swagger specifications
88. Write endpoint documentation
89. Document error codes and responses
90. Create usage examples for each endpoint
91. Add docstrings to all methods
92. Implement CORS handling
93. Set up environment-based configuration
94. Add database connection pooling
95. Implement caching with Redis
96. Set up CI/CD pipeline basics
97. Create deployment checklist
98. Write deployment documentation
99. Performance optimization review and refactoring

---

## Key Skills You'll Build

### **Backend Architecture**
- RESTful API design principles
- Separation of concerns (models, serializers, views)
- Scalable project structure
- Database modeling and relationships

### **Django & DRF Mastery**
- Model creation and ORM query optimization
- Serializer validation and custom logic
- ViewSet and Router configuration
- Middleware and authentication pipelines

### **Authentication & Security**
- User authentication mechanisms
- Token generation and validation
- Permission and authorization models
- CORS and CSRF protection

### **Data Management**
- Complex query filtering and searching
- Pagination strategies
- Relationship serialization
- Data validation and normalization

### **Testing & Quality**
- Unit and integration testing
- Fixture and factory patterns
- Coverage analysis
- Edge case identification

### **API Design**
- Consistent status codes and error responses
- Versioning strategies
- Documentation generation
- Rate limiting and throttling

### **Performance Engineering**
- Query optimization (N+1 problem solving)
- Database indexing strategies
- Caching implementation
- Load testing

---

## Sample Problem Types
